algorithm: Dispatches the pending battle-presentation transfer mode, copies or transforms the 0x4000-byte graphics buffer, clears the pending flag, and advances the presentation counter.
evidence: The drafting-wave m2c source was already extent- and branch-topology-exact but differed in 40 halfwords because it modeled the IWRAM call-via-r3 veneers as fictional four-argument functions.
Replacing those calls with ordinary typed function-pointer calls through 0x03001388 and 0x03000168 preserved the output but did not change the residual by itself.

Wrapping the two indirect-call forms in ordinary static inline helpers separated GCC 2.96's otherwise merged 0x4000 constant pseudo. This removed the extra r7 save, restored work/source to r6/r5, and reduced 40 differing halfwords to 3 with zero wrong instructions.

The remaining difference is one three-instruction scheduling permutation in case 1: candidate loads the 0x06004000 destination before moving the source and shifting the size; the reference loads it afterward. Every other instruction, branch, pool word, and extent is exact.

bounded_source_probe.note: The decoder exposes only the two legal statement/evaluation-order variants for this source shape; both preserve or regress the localized schedule. Additional hand probes covered specialized inline-helper signatures, direct and nested destination helpers, case-local source/destination/size temporaries, and assignment expressions.

compiler_decision.finding: The four independent call-argument instructions have equal scheduling priority and dependency class. rank_for_schedule therefore falls through to original INSN_LUID order. The candidate RTL creates the destination literal before the source move and size shift; the shipped reference implies the opposite original source expansion order. No scheduling flag changes that local tie without regressing the rest of the owner.

decision: Retain the byte-exact structured assembly as a proven local compiler-scheduling mismatch. The complete ordinary-C reconstruction remains the semantic source artifact; all 248 owner bytes now count as DONE under the same evidence gate as the existing compiler_local_scheduling_mismatch family.
